column1: # p170. The permissive-LMS hole, re-opened on purpose. verticals/solutions.md has said the
# permissive LMS route is "exactly two" (Sakai ECL-2.0, Kolibri MIT) for EIGHT passes.
# p170's vertical-platform query named two candidates it had not tested. Both were verified on the
# open channel (treeless clone, root grant body read, folded word-diff against canonical Apache-2.0).
repo
formalms/formalms
OpenOLAT/OpenOLAT
# formalms: NO root grant file at all. The grant is at html/license.txt and it is the GNU GPL
# version 2, June 1991, verbatim (5 occurrences of "GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE", 0 of "Apache").
# The only Apache text in its tree is a vendored jsdoc prettify file. A secondary source called
# Forma LMS "Apache 2.0"; the artifact says GPL-2.0. Caught BEFORE it entered the shelf.
# Also recorded: formalms ships its licence in NINE languages (english, spanish, portuguese,
# italian, german, french, croatian, bosnian, tamil) under html/lib/System/license/. Localised
# licence text is a hazard, not a feature -- nothing in the tree says which language governs.
# OpenOLAT: folded word-diff vs canonical Apache-2.0 is 90 added / 159 removed, and EVERY hunk is
# at or after word 1410 -- i.e. entirely inside the APPENDIX. The operative sections 1-9 are
# IDENTICAL. What replaces the appendix is two ATTRIBUTION statements (the original OLAT base at
# the University of Zurich; the openolat.org base initiated by frentix GmbH). They add no term,
# grant no right and impose no restriction beyond preserving the notices. NOTICE.TXT independently
# states "Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0" and names the copyright holders.
# NOT A NEW FINDING, and that is the point: agents/top.md recorded this at PASS 138, in these
# words -- "Apache-2.0 verbatim with the appendix replaced by attribution notices" -- and recorded
# the byte count 10 982 B. p170 re-measured 10 982 B independently, 32 passes later.
# THE DEFECT IS INTERNAL: verticals/solutions.md:784 (an older block) carries OpenOLAT as
# "Apache-2.0, the cleanest fork target of any LMS on this shelf". Line 39, p169's CURRENT routing
# table, omits it, and line 49 says the permissive route is "exactly two". Same file, two blocks,
# contradicting each other. See T216.
